grid.value: 0 = no building; otherwise ceil(top T.P. m)+offset over every building that touches the cell, outlines widened by 1 m
grid.height: max(LOD1/LOD2 top, LOD1 base + measuredHeight); LOD2/3 roof faces only where they explain measuredHeight within 1 m; no measuredHeight: LOD top + 3 m
grid.encoding: gzip of uint8 low bytes then high bytes of int16 row-wise differences (row-major)

excludes: bridges, elevated roads and railways, trees and other non-building structures are not in the grid
meshValue: [first 16 hex of the file sha256, highest top m]
